Implementation is complete and verified.

## What was built

`POST /orders/:id/apply-coupon` now discounts a pending order with one coupon, end to end.

- [orderService.ts](/work/src/services/orderService.ts) — `applyCoupon(id, body)`: normalizes the code (trim + upper-case), then runs the guards in exactly the spec's precedence order (body → order exists → pending → not already applied → coupon exists → active → `validFrom <= now < validUntil` → usage limit → minimum amount), computes the discount (`FIXED` value or floored percentage, capped by `maxDiscountCents` then by the order amount), and derives `finalAmountCents` from the same numbers. Time comes from the injected `Clock`.
- [orderRepository.ts](/work/src/repositories/orderRepository.ts) — one transactional method (`BEGIN IMMEDIATE` / `COMMIT`, `ROLLBACK` on any error) that updates the order, inserts the `coupon_redemptions` row and increments `used_count`, re-checking the status/coupon/usage invariants inside the transaction. No SQL was added outside `repositories/`.
- [orders.ts](/work/src/routes/orders.ts) parses only the id via `parseId` and passes the body through, so the response is the re-read order and deep-equals a follow-up `GET /orders/:id`.
- [applyCoupon.test.ts](/work/tests/applyCoupon.test.ts) — 26 new tests covering AC-01…AC-10, every error code, precedence, and side-effect-free rejections.

## OpenSpec artifacts

`openspec/changes/order-apply-coupon/` — `proposal.md`, `specs/order-coupons/spec.md` (new capability, 20 requirements with scenarios), `design.md`, `tasks.md`. `openspec validate --strict` passes and the apply tracker reads 9/9 tasks, `state: all_done`.

One planning note: task 1.2 was conditional on needing a coupon-repo write path; the whole write set fit in the single transactional repository method, so I rewrote that task to reflect the decision (keeping the transaction inside one repository) rather than dropping it. Your `TASK.md` and the existing `tests/orders.test.ts` are untouched, and `npm run build` plus `npm test` (31 tests) both pass. Nothing was archived — say the word if you want the change archived or the spec delta synced into `openspec/specs/`.
